main_text.l: maxima fere misericordiæ. species, artificum & operariorum opera vti. Quid speciem dico:Est summum ge-nus misericordiæ. Egestatis namq;ma[?] ter imò nouerca est luxus & otium. At his malis mederi potest, si magi-stratus, vt Paulus monet, ἀτάκτως[?] cohibet, otiosos non fert, laborare & aliquid operis facere volentes condu-cit, inuitos autem adigit ad labores, his inquam artibus efficitur, vt in a-bundantia rerum, nec luxu, nec otio torpescant: nec in penuria, labori-bus & frugalitate assuefacti, egeant. Hæ fuere superioribus annis, Amplissimi nostri magistratus constitu-tiones, hæc vitæ & morum emenda-tio, hæc erga egenos liberalitas, erga ignauos legum seueritas.
Misericors ergo Deus, pro singula-ri sua erga genus humanum, in pri-mis erga Remp. Tigurinam veræ Ecclesiæ nutricem, misericordía & benignitate, consumpto omni frumento,

page.notes: The Greek word after "monet," appears to be ἀτάκτως (ataktōs) but the letters are faint and the accent and final letters are doubtful, so it is marked [?]. "namq;ma" after "Egestatis" is a doubtful reading of a faint abbreviation with a damaged final syllable. Printed "dico:Est" keeps the colon as it appears. Line-end "beni / gnitate" shows no clear hyphen, so it is written as one word.
